contemporaneous_binary_inference.reason_not_usable: Matching mtimes make the post-run candidate plausible but do not prove which bytes T7 loaded. Backfilling either digest would manufacture identity evidence.

d2g6_legitimate_preset.conclusion: The selected D2g6 strategy preset is ablation-02. The base preset is only a diagnostic control and cannot substitute for selected-preset identity evidence.

base_control_reproduction.basis: Existing governed Model=4 tester outputs were re-parsed; no terminal was started.

timer_facts: QM_FrameworkInit arms EventSetTimer(1) only when MQL_TESTER == 0.
QM_FrameworkOnTimer calls only FTMO broker-day refresh and chart-UI refresh; it does not call Strategy_EntrySignal, Strategy_ManageOpenPosition, or a trade operation.
QM5_10706 evaluates entries only from OnTick after QM_IsNewBar(PERIOD_H1).

source_change.summary: Added the side_ok market-side/stops-level guard to MON_SWEEP_BE_LOCK. The predecessor source SHA maps to the parent state; the rebuilt source SHA maps to this guarded state.

mechanism.conclusion: The new guard delayed installation of the same break-even stop until a later qualifying tick; the stop then fired two seconds after modification and three seconds after the predecessor exit.

economic_and_live_consequence.observed_replay: ECONOMIC_NULL_FOR_THIS_ONE_BASE_CONTROL_REPLAY_ONLY: price, volume, commission, swap, per-deal profit, balance, and total net PnL are exact.
economic_and_live_consequence.general_live_consequence: NOT_ECONOMICALLY_NULL_AS_A_MECHANICS_CHANGE: later stop installation can leave a position exposed for additional ticks and can change whether, when, and at what price it exits under a different live tick path.
economic_and_live_consequence.entry_consequence: No entry can fire from OnTimer; all 151 entry times were exact.

disposition.required_path: Run a fresh selected-preset Q02 for the rebuilt identity through a governed seed path that does not invent the missing historical EX5 hash, then run its own Q03-Q10 chain unless Fable ratifies a contract that this pair actually satisfies.
